example_checks.scope: Downloaded example files only; not proof of current full matrices or cohort enrollment counts.

global_join_rules: Use study-qualified participant IDs; stable cross-study person equivalence requires source evidence.
GEO series may contain several harmonized cohorts; source accession is not a unique cohort key.
Keep longitudinal specimens, technical replicates, cells and participant counts distinct.
Do not sum paired bulk/single-cell studies or tissue subsets as independent subjects.
Do not infer clinical challenge from a pathogen or mixed-exposure tag alone.
